result_preview.description: This data product combines product modification data, supply chain updates, and operational transition information to quantify the human capital implications of business changes. It identifies training gaps, resource constraints, and capability misalignments triggered by product and process evolution. The insights support HR business partners in developing targeted capability-building strategies and managing organizational change adoption.
